description: NSF-Goali: Future Underground Landscape -Learning from Large Excavations in a Complex Urban Environment - Field Monitoring and Testing data is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Youssef Hashash, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (illinois.edu). The major expansion of the Los Angeles Metro system provided the unique opportunity to collect and analyze data needed to improve excavation performance. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gjnk-0q88. Keywords: Excavations, Urban Construction, Surface Settlements, Tar Soils, Excavation Stiffness. Published 2025-01-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
